title: CBCQuotation
description: Structured result of a CBC Phase 0-6 estimate. Every line must carry a cost source and a plan/catalog citation; the audit gate rejects lines that do not.

planSet.description: Filename of the bid set this estimate was read from.

projectState.description: e.g. "PA (0.0% Sales Tax - Supply-Only)". Tax: OH ~8%, KY 6.5%, all other states and Canada 0%.

doorLines.description: Division 08 openings, grouped by door tag.

accessoryLines.description: Division 10 washroom accessories and hand dryers. Uncarried items appear here with costBasis "[not carried on shelf — outside RFQ required]" and no vendor named.

frpLines.description: Division 06 64 FRP panels, trims and adhesive. Provisional per Open Item 5.

rfis.description: The RFI register: every substitution, provisional constant and unconfirmed item.

tag.description: Opening tag or item mark, exactly as it appears on the schedule.

unitSale.description: Sale $ EA = Cost / (1 - Margin). Never a list price.

costBasis.description: cost_source plus cost_source_detail, e.g. "catalog_list_x_multiplier (Hager .29)". One of: catalog_list_x_multiplier, p21_last_po, manual_wholesaler_net, vendor_rfq, custom_fabricator, not_specified.

citations.description: Audit trail tags: [schedule] [spec] [note] [drawing] [catalog] [catalog-page] [not carried] [not indexed] [not stated].

confidence.description: FR-8 match confidence. Omit or null when not assessed.

pricingStatus.description: FR-16 pricing state. Default priced when a unitSale is present.
